<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>

<head>
<META http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8">
<META HTTP-EQUIV="Pragma" CONTENT="no_cache">
<META NAME="ATEN International Co Ltd." CONTENT="(c) ATEN International Co Ltd. 2010">
<title>Supermicro BMC Login</title>
<link rel="icon" href="../images/logo.png" type="image/png">

<style>
    html {
        position: relative;
        min-height: 100%;
        overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    footer {
        position: absolute;
        bottom: 10px;
        width: 100%;
        color: #2878DB;
        margin-bottom: 0px;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    ::selection {
        color:#14293b; background-color: #ffed7f
    }

    .login-form form {
        border-radius:10px 10px 10px 10px;
    }

    .input-group label {
        color: #c7c7c7;
        font-weight: normal;
    }

    .login-input {
        height: 26px;
        border-radius: 13px;
        border: solid 1px #19334a;
        background-color: #19334a;
        border-image: none !important;
        border-style: none !important;
        color:#c7c7c7;
    }

    .login-input.login-error {
        height: 26px;
        border-radius: 13px;
        border: solid 1px #fb69a3 !important;;
        background-color: #19334a;
        border-image: none !important;
        border-style: none !important;
        color:#c7c7c7;
    }

    .login-input:focus {
        outline:0;
        border-radius: 13px;
        border: solid 1px #44adff!important;
        background-color: #000;
    }

    .login-input.login-error:focus {
        outline:0;
        border-radius: 13px;
        border: solid 1px #fb69a3!important;
        background-color: #000;
    }

    .login-btn {
        width: 90%;
        height:26px;
        border-radius: 13px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 6px 0 #87d1cc;
        border: solid 0.5px #44adff;
        background-color: #194875;
        color: white;
        font-weight: bold;
        margin-top: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 30px;
    }

    .login-btn:hover {
        width: 90%;
        height:26px;
        object-fit: contain;
        border-radius:13px;
        border: solid 0.5px #44adff;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 6px 0 #87d1cc;
        background-color: #225c94;
        color: #85d0cc;;
        font-weight: bold;
        margin-bottom: 30px;
    }

    .login-btn:focus {
        outline:0;
    }

    .input-group {
        display: initial;
    }

    ::placeholder { /* Chrome, Firefox, Opera, Safari 10.1+ */
        color: #dfdfdf;
        opacity: 1; /* Firefox */
        font-style: italic;
        font-size: 10px;
    }

    :-ms-input-placeholder { /* Internet Explorer 10-11 */
        color: #dfdfdf;
        font-style: italic;
        font-size: 10px;
    }

    ::-ms-input-placeholder { /* Microsoft Edge */
        color: #dfdfdf;
        font-style: italic;
        font-size: 10px;
    }

    .image {
        vertical-align: middle;
        display: table-cell;
        width: 52px;
    }
    .modal-title-3-btn {
        width: 100%;
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 14px;
        color: #6f9ccb;
        font-weight: bold;
    }
    .browsers {
        margin: 20px 0 0 0;
    }
    .browsers-last {
        margin-bottom: 0px;
    }
    .browsers::after {
        content: " ";
        display: table;
        clear: both;
    }
    .browser {
        float: left;
        width: 120px;
        display: inline;
        padding: 5px;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .browser-title {
        color: grey;
        text-decoration: none;
        background-color: transparent;
        font-size: small;
    }

    .logo {
        text-align: center;
        background-size: contain;
        background-repeat: no-repeat;
        background-position-x: 50%;
        height: 50px;
        background-size: 32px 32px;
    }

    .logo-chrome {
        background-image: url(../images/logo-chrome.png?v=D);
    }
    .logo-firefox {
        background-image: url(../images/logo-firefox.png?v=D);
    }
    .logo-opera {
        background-image: url(../images/logo-opera.png?v=D);
    }

attr_html.title: Atlassian Crowd - Identity management for web apps
attr_http.body:
Atlassian

Atlassian Crowd

Crowd — Identity management for web apps

Crowd is an application security framework that handles authentication and authorisation calls for your web applications. With Crowd you can quickly integrate web applications into a single security architecture that supports single sign-on and centralised identity management.

The application is divided into two parts:

  • The administration console is a clean and powerful web interface to manage directories, users and their security rights.
  • The integration API provides a platform neutral way to integrate web applications into a single security architecture. With the integration API applications can quickly access user information or perform security checks.

The first time you access the Crowd console, you will be walked through the initial configuration of your deployment.

attr_html.title: Atlassian Crowd - Identity management for web apps
attr_http.body:
Atlassian

Atlassian Crowd

Crowd — Identity management for web apps

Crowd is an application security framework that handles authentication and authorisation calls for your web applications. With Crowd you can quickly integrate web applications into a single security architecture that supports single sign-on and centralised identity management.

The application is divided into two parts:

  • The administration console is a clean and powerful web interface to manage directories, users and their security rights.
  • The integration API provides a platform neutral way to integrate web applications into a single security architecture. With the integration API applications can quickly access user information or perform security checks.

The first time you access the Crowd console, you will be walked through the initial configuration of your deployment.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>

<head>
<META http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8">
<META HTTP-EQUIV="Pragma" CONTENT="no_cache">
<META NAME="ATEN International Co Ltd." CONTENT="(c) ATEN International Co Ltd. 2010">
<title>Supermicro BMC Login</title>
<link rel="icon" href="../images/logo.png" type="image/png">

<style>
    html {
        position: relative;
        min-height: 100%;
        overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    footer {
        position: absolute;
        bottom: 10px;
        width: 100%;
        color: #2878DB;
        margin-bottom: 0px;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    ::selection {
        color:#14293b; background-color: #ffed7f
    }

    .login-form form {
        border-radius:10px 10px 10px 10px;
    }

    .input-group label {
        color: #c7c7c7;
        font-weight: normal;
    }

    .login-input {
        height: 26px;
        border-radius: 13px;
        border: solid 1px #19334a;
        background-color: #19334a;
        border-image: none !important;
        border-style: none !important;
        color:#c7c7c7;
    }

    .login-input.login-error {
        height: 26px;
        border-radius: 13px;

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>

<head>
<META http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=utf-8">
<META HTTP-EQUIV="Pragma" CONTENT="no_cache">

<title>Supermicro BMC Login</title>
<link rel="icon" href="../images/logo.png" type="image/png">

<style>
    html {
        position: relative;
        min-height: 100%;
        overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    footer {
        position: absolute;
        bottom: 10px;
        width: 100%;
        color: #2878DB;
        margin-bottom: 0px;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    ::selection {
        color:#14293b; background-color: #ffed7f
    }

    .login-form form {
        border-radius:10px 10px 10px 10px;
    }

    .input-group label {
        color: #c7c7c7;
        font-weight: normal;
    }

    .login-input {
        height: 26px;
        border-radius: 13px;
        border: solid 1px #19334a;
        background-color: #19334a;
        border-image: none !important;
        border-style: none !important;
        color:#c7c7c7;
    }

    .login-input.login-error {
        height: 26px;
        border-radius: 13px;
        border: solid 1px #fb69a3 !important;;
        background-color: #19334a;
        border-image: none !important;
        border-style: none !important;
        color:#c7c7c7;
    }

    .login-input:focus {
        outline:0;
        border-radius: 13px;
        border: solid 1px #44adff!important;
        background-color: #000;
    }

    .login-input.login-error:focus {
        outline:0;
        border-radius: 13px;
        border: solid 1px #fb69a3!important;
        background-color: #000;
    }

    .login-btn {
        width: 90%;
        height:26px;
        border-radius: 13px;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 6px 0 #87d1cc;
        border: solid 0.5px #44adff;
        background-color: #194875;
        color: white;
        font-weight: bold;
        margin-top: 10px;
        margin-bottom: 30px;
    }

    .login-btn:hover {
        width: 90%;
        height:26px;
        object-fit: contain;
        border-radius:13px;
        border: solid 0.5px #44adff;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 6px 0 #87d1cc;
        background-color: #225c94;
        color: #85d0cc;;
        font-weight: bold;
        margin-bottom: 30px;
    }

    .login-btn:focus {
        outline:0;
    }

    .input-group {
        display: initial;
    }

    ::placeholder { /* Chrome, Firefox, Opera, Safari 10.1+ */
        color: #dfdfdf;
        opacity: 1; /* Firefox */
        font-style: italic;
        font-size: 10px;
    }

    :-ms-input-placeholder { /* Internet Explorer 10-11 */
        color: #dfdfdf;
        font-style: italic;
        font-size: 10px;
    }

    ::-ms-input-placeholder { /* Microsoft Edge */
        color: #dfdfdf;
        font-style: italic;
        font-size: 10px;
    }

    .image {
        vertical-align: middle;
        display: table-cell;
        width: 52px;
    }
    .modal-title-3-btn {
        width: 100%;
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 14px;
        color: #6f9ccb;
        font-weight: bold;
    }
    .browsers {
        margin: 20px 0 0 0;
    }
    .browsers-last {
        margin-bottom: 0px;
    }
    .browsers::after {
        content: " ";
        display: table;
        clear: both;
    }
    .browser {
        float: left;
        width: 120px;
        display: inline;
        padding: 5px;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .browser-title {
        color: grey;
        text-decoration: none;
        background-color: transparent;
        font-size: small;
    }

    .logo {
        text-align: center;
        background-size: contain;
        background-repeat: no-repeat;
        background-position-x: 50%;
        height: 50px;
        background-size: 32px 32px;
    }

    .logo-chrome {
        background-image: url(../images/logo-chrome.png?v=D);
    }
    .logo-firefox {
        background-image: url(../images/logo-firefox.png?v=D);
    }
    .logo-opera {
        background-image: url(../images/logo-opera.png?v=D);
    }
